summary: Second autonomous-work block under the operator's 'pick the next job ... good reason ... grounded ... until we get the website' directive. Four commits landed. Phase 3 (e789d2c) — Layer 2 inter-app deeplink pathway: new sign-request feature with SignRequest/SignGrant/SignDecline types, base64url-decoded URL param + strict shape validation, plain-English per-kind approval screen showing claimed origin AND actual callback host, approve calls wallet.attest + holds + queues anchoring + redirects to callback with grant, decline redirects with structured reason. Phase 4 library (c0bcda1) — selective leaf disclosure: metaHash exported from envelope.ts, real disclosureProof + verifyDisclosureProof in field-tree.ts (DisclosureProofBundle = meta + leaf + sibling-hash steps + signatures), five new tests covering round-trip, non-disclosure property, tamper detection, path errors. Phase 4 wallet UI (6ee7f34) — disclosure feature with leafIndex helper, ShareProofModal (pick-leaf-then-generate-then-copy), public /verify route outside AuthGate, parseDisclosureProof shape-validator. PLAN.md refresh (39664c4) — brings the phase map current with shipped reality. Branch and main both at 39664c4.

why.text: Operator directive: 'pick the next job plan it out keep up the good clean habits double check everything don't trust verify make sure you have a good reason to do anything and you're following the Claude MD and stay in grounded. Continue with the next piece until we get the website.' Treated as sustained autonomous-work with strict discipline. Phase 3 picked first because it was the next-named feature on PLAN.md/DESIGN.md and serves thesis-principle #2 (every other app connects to the wallet to get something signed; other apps never hold keys themselves). Phase 4 picked next because the library's field tree was literally designed for selective disclosure with the v1.1 slot stubbed and the operator's diary-wedge brief named it as a v1 feature. PLAN.md refresh chosen as the closing housekeeping piece because the file was meaningfully out of date with shipped reality and the operator may pull it alongside the Netlify wire-up.

files_changed: Four commits, ~20 files: sign-request feature (7 files) + disclosure feature (5 files) + library envelope.ts/field-tree.ts/field-tree.test.mjs + App routes + journal detail + features-registry + PLAN.md
outcome.tests_passing: root 16/16 on every commit. tapit-attest 82 total (was 78) / 78 pass / 0 fail / 4 skipped — four new disclosure tests pass, baseline corrupted-fixture skips unchanged.
outcome.notes: Library-seam audit clean on every commit. Adversarial diff review caught one copy bug pre-push (SignApprovalScreen busy-state referenced a useMemo'd value only resolvable in ready-state; tightened to just 'Signing…'). Keys-never-leave audit clean: sign-request only redirects with public envelopes; disclosure proofs contain only public meta + leaf + sibling hashes + signatures, no private key ever appears. File-size rule still satisfied (largest source 273 lines).

uncertainty: End-to-end against the live Netlify+Supabase deploy still pending operator. New paths to walk: sign-request deeplink round-trip (third-party constructs URL → wallet decodes → approve → callback receives grant), disclosure proof round-trip (pick a leaf in one tab → paste into /verify in another → math checks), /verify accessible publicly without auth (it's outside AuthGate).
next: Pausing at a strong stop. Phase 5 (social recovery + Mycelium) requires MYCELIUM_NETWORK_SPEC.md to exist first per existing doctrine — that spec is operator-side work the brief named as input. Phase 6 (full-keypair family custody) is marked optional in PLAN.md now that Phase 2.6's lighter identity-by-attestation model already covers the operator's grandchild scenario. Phase 7+ are explicit non-goals for v1. Remaining follow-ups (multi-tab, HEIC re-encode, pre-commit script, bundle audit, OTS fixture, zip cleanup) are all non-blocking. The v1 surface is now feature-complete for the operator's described use cases — diary + photos + documents + witness signing + custody handoff + inter-app deeplink + selective disclosure + idle-lock + anchor-lifecycle.
